text_en: David left there and escaped to the cave of Adullam; when his brothers and all his father’s house heard of it, they went down there to him.
text_cn: 达味离开那里，逃到了阿杜蓝山洞；他的兄弟和父亲全家听说这事，都来到他那里。

text_en: Everyone who was in distress, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered to him; and he became captain over them. Those who were with him numbered about four hundred.
text_cn: 凡受迫害、负债、心中忧苦的人，都投奔到他那里，他便成了他们的首领；此时随从他的约有四百人。

text_en: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab. He said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and mother come to you, until I know what God will do for me. ”
text_cn: 达味从那里来到摩阿布的米兹帕，对摩阿布王说﹕“求你让我父母来你们这里，直到我明白天主对我有什么计划时为止。”

text_en: He left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.
text_cn: 达味把他们留在摩阿布王那里：达味在山寨里住了多久，他们在他那里也住了多久。

text_en: Then the prophet Gad said to David, “Do not remain in the stronghold; leave, and go into the land of Judah. ” So David left, and went into the forest of Hereth.
text_cn: 加得先知对达味说：“你不要住在这山寨里，你要到犹大地方去！”达味就去了，来到赫勒特树林。

text_en: Saul heard that David and those who were with him had been located. Saul was sitting at Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree on the height, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.
text_cn: 一日，撒乌耳正坐在基贝亚高处的一棵柽（chēng）柳下，手里拿着枪，他的臣仆都侍立左右，听说达味和跟随他的人已联合起来，

text_en: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjaminites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, will he make you all commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?
text_cn: 遂对侍立他左右的臣仆说：“本雅明的子孙，你们听：难道叶瑟的儿子也要赐给你们每人庄田和葡萄园，或把你们都立为千夫长或百夫长，

text_en: Is that why all of you have conspired against me? No one discloses to me when my son makes a league with the son of Jesse, none of you is sorry for me or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as he is doing today. ”
text_cn: 好使你们都同谋来陷害我？我的儿子和叶瑟的儿子结盟，谁也没有告诉我；我的儿子煽动我的臣仆来反对我，仇视我，像今日一样，你们中没有一个人怜恤我，来通知我！”

text_en: Doeg the Edomite, who was in charge of Saul’s servants, answered, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech son of Ahitub;
text_cn: 作撒乌耳臣仆之长的厄东人多厄格就答说：“我看见叶瑟的儿子到过诺布，去见阿希突布的儿子阿希默肋客。

text_en: he inquired of the Lord for him, gave him provisions, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine. ”
text_cn: 他为达味求问了上主，给了他食物，也把培肋舍特人哥肋雅的刀给了他。”

text_en: The king sent for the priest Ahimelech son of Ahitub and for all his father’s house, the priests who were at Nob; and all of them came to the king.
text_cn: 君王遂派人去叫阿希突布的儿子，大司祭阿希默肋客和他父亲全家，即诺布所有的司祭；他们就都来到君王面前，

text_en: Saul said, “Listen now, son of Ahitub. ” He answered, “Here I am, my lord. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳说：“阿希突布的儿子，你听！”他答说：“是，我主！”

text_en: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, by giving him bread and a sword, and by inquiring of God for him, so that he has risen against me, to lie in wait, as he is doing today? ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳对他说：“你为什么和叶瑟的儿子同谋陷害我，给他食物和刀剑，为他求问天主，使他起来反对我，仇视我，像今日一样？”

text_en: Then Ahimelech answered the king, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David? He is the king’s son-in-law, and is quick to do your bidding, and is honored in your house.
text_cn: 阿希默肋客答复君王说：“在你的臣仆中，有谁如达味那样忠诚可靠呢？他是大王的女婿，又是护卫长，在你朝廷中是最受重视的人。

text_en: Is today the first time that I have inquired of God for him? By no means! Do not let the king impute anything to his servant or to any member of my father’s house; for your servant has known nothing of all this, much or little. ”
text_cn: 难道我是今天才开始为他求问天主吗？决不是！请大王不要加害自己的仆人和我父全家，因为你仆人一点也不知道这事。”

text_en: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house. ”
text_cn: 王说：“阿希默肋客，你和你父亲全家都该死！”

text_en: The king said to the guard who stood around him, “Turn and kill the priests of the Lord , because their hand also is with David; they knew that he fled, and did not disclose it to me. ” But the servants of the king would not raise their hand to attack the priests of the Lord .
text_cn: 王遂吩咐立在他左右的侍卫说：“你们过去，杀死上主的司祭！因为他们与达味携手，知道他逃跑，却不来告诉我。”但是君王的臣仆不敢下手杀上主的司祭。

text_en: Then the king said to Doeg, “You, Doeg, turn and attack the priests. ” Doeg the Edomite turned and attacked the priests; on that day he killed eighty-five who wore the linen ephod.
text_cn: 王遂对多厄格说：“你过去杀死司祭！”厄东人多厄格就过去杀死了司祭。那一天他杀了八十五位身穿细麻“厄弗得”的人。

text_en: Nob, the city of the priests, he put to the sword; men and women, children and infants, oxen, donkeys, and sheep, he put to the sword.
text_cn: 至于那座诺布司祭城，无论男女、幼童或乳儿，甚至连那里的牛、驴、羊，都用利剑杀尽。

text_en: But one of the sons of Ahimelech son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.
text_cn: 阿希突布之子阿希默肋客的一个儿子，名叫厄贝雅塔尔的，脱险跑到了达味那里。

text_en: Abiathar told David that Saul had killed the priests of the Lord .
text_cn: 厄贝雅塔尔告诉达味，撒乌耳杀了上主的司祭。

text_en: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the lives of all your father’s house.
text_cn: 达味对厄贝雅塔尔说：“那一天我已知道，因为厄东人多厄格在那里，他必要向撒乌耳报告，你父全家的性命，我全负责。

text_en: Stay with me, and do not be afraid; for the one who seeks my life seeks your life; you will be safe with me. ”
text_cn: 你住在我这里，不要害怕；谁想谋害你，就是想谋害我；你同我一起必得安全。”
